title: Shared Photo-or-Note Frequency by Month
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=touchpoint:log
| search touchpoint_type="photo" OR touchpoint_type="note"
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as touchpoints by _time touchpoint_type
| sort - _time
description: Tracks shared notes and photo touchpoints over time and breaks it out by touchpoint type.
value: Lightweight touchpoints often keep closeness alive between bigger conversations, so their frequency matters.
implementation: Send shared notes and photo touchpoints events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1mon granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of shared notes and photo touchpoints by touchpoint type.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how shared notes and photo touchpoints changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
